'''Beef''' was a [[humanoid]] [[pirate]] active during the [[New Republic Era]]. A member of a [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]], he originally served under [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] until a mutiny ousted him in favor of [[Brutus]]. When Silvo escaped from his [[brig]] at [[Borgo Prime|Starport Borgo]], Beef rallied pirates to search for the runaway and was later involved in the pursuit of him, resulting in Silvo being apprehended on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]]. After Silvo [[Blaster|gunned]] Brutus down to regain his position as captain, Beef took part in the [[Invasion of At Attin]], rounding up the citizens to work for the pirates. The invasion, however, proved unsuccessful when a [[New Republic]] [[squadron]] arrived to the rescue.

==Biography==
[[File:Beef-SkeletonCrewEp5.jpg|thumb|200px|left|Beef on Lanupa.]]
The [[humanoid]] [[pirate]] Beef was a member of the [[Silvo's pirates|crew]] led by [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 101" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the crew [[Silvo's pirate raid|attacked]] a [[Unidentified bulk freighter (New Republic Era)|merchant freighter]], capturing the [[Bulk freighter|ship]] as its [[merchant]] crew attempted fight off the pirates. Beef was with the rest of the crew when they breached the [[Magnetic seal|magnetically sealed]] vault of the freighter. After the vault was opened and the pirates realized that it was empty, Beef participated in the mutiny against their captain Silvo for leading them to an empty vault.<ref name="SC 101" />

Somme [[time]] later, Beef was on [[Borgo Prime]] after Silvo, [[Wim]], [[Neel]], [[KB]] and [[Fern]] escaped from the [[brig]].<ref name="SC 103" /> He<ref name="SC 102 AD" /> proceeded to rally his fellow pirates to search the port for Silvo, announcing it was official business of captain [[Brutus]].<ref name="SC 103" />

Later, Beef saw as Brutus was about to execute Silvo. The former captain convinced his former crew that he could lead them to [[At Attin]]'s treasure. Soon after, Silvo killed Brutus to retake his place of captain.<ref name="SC 107">{{SkeletonCrew|We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Beef first appeared in the [[2024]] [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', played by [[Dominic Burgess]].<ref name="SC 101" /> The character's design was conceptualized by<ref name="Beef BtS">{{Instagram|username=redwizard|url=p/DQ2SIgsEkoQ|name=[[Cristina Waltz]]|date=2025-11-10|quote=Next up from Skeleton Crew: Beef — what a character! 💥 This Borgo space pirate was inspired by (or perhaps a patient of 👀) the infamous Doctor Cornelius Evazan. Actor Dominic Burgess brought Beef to life on screen and was an absolute delight in the makeup chair. When Alexei and I began planning this design, we knew Scott Stoddard was the artist to make it happen. Scott masterfully sculpted a four-piece silicone makeup — complete with Beef's gnarly teeth and arm scarring — and led the application alongside Mike Ornealez, with support from Mike Mekash and Ian Goodwin throughout the season. Our contact lens tech was Diana Hansen. The molds were crafted by Ian Goodwin, Helen Snell, and Jen Grable, with all silicone appliances run by Crystal Gomez. All done in our workshop. Topping it all off — Beef's fantastic space mullet wig, designed and styled by Lane Friedman and built by Rob Pickens💫 #skeletoncrew #starwars #childrenfamilyemmys|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/EDo5S|archivefile=File:CristinaWaltz-BeefBTS1-IG.png|archivefile2=File:CristinaWaltz-BeefBTS2-IG.png|archivefile3=File:CristinaWaltz-BeefBTS3-IG.png|archivefile4=File:CristinaWaltz-BeefBTS4-IG.png}}</ref> the heads of the series' prosthetic makeup department,<ref name="SC 101" /> [[Cristina Waltz]] and [[Alexei Dmitriew]], and was inspired by the ''[[Star Wars]]'' character [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]]. The character's four-piece silicone makeup and teeth and arm scarring were sculpted by [[Scott Stoddard]], who also led the application process together with [[Mike Ornealez]] and support by [[Mike Mekash]] and [[Ian Goodwin]]. Beef's molds were crafted by Goodwin, [[Helen Snell]] and [[Jen Grable]] with the silicone appliances done by [[Crystal Gomez]] and a clay sculpt of his face was also done. [[Diana Hansen]] was responsible for the contact lenses and his mullet wig was designed and styled by [[Lane Friedman]] and built by [[Rob Pickens]].<ref name="Beef BtS" />
